question: When does a four-frame endpoint become a self-fed rollout?
boxes: Warm from ground truth. Every retained age precedes the prediction origin.
The v2 endpoint stops here. Evaluate the fourth-frame error separately from context age.
Only in a rollout: update causal memory with predictions, advance by four, predict again.
limitation: Legacy or separately authorized rollout path. No backpropagation through the full forecast in the v2 endpoint.
